'''Bellarius Drade''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] assigned to protect and monitor the [[Precipitator|Imperial Precipitator]] [[Minas-Coth Cray]]. While on the mission, Drade sensed the presence of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child, named [[Djinn Kylo]], and he took the boy as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], hoping to create his own splinter group.<ref name="GT" />
